verdict.rationale: Conductor's changelog introduces 'routines' that run agents on a schedule or via GitHub Action, which is the core of this story. Cloud sandboxes keep agents working after you close your laptop and can run builds and tests without step-by-step confirmation. The API also lets you create workspaces and send prompts programmatically for custom triggers. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of routines (configuration, trigger types, limits), evidence of end-to-end autonomous maintenance or fix loops (e.g., auto-fixing failing checks and opening PRs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of routines.
